title: Turkish Beef Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy dish from Turkish cuisine, perfect for a weekend dinner. Marinated beef kebabs grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Exotic Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern grocery stores

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together exotic spice mix, red pepper flakes, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add the beef flank steak to the marinade and mix well to coat.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread the marinated beef onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
6. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach your desired level of doneness.
7. Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
8. Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or roasted vegetables.
